summary: Backend-only retest of the bug where the payment-reminder event was missing from the realtime feed. Logged in as admin donas, started POST /api/admin/inscricoes/lembrete-pagamento and polled the job status until it was 'concluido' with enviados>=1. GET /api/admin/dashboard/realtime?limit=10 now includes a kind='lembrete' event whose description starts with 'Lembrete de pagamento enviado -'. The other event kinds (pix_generated, access, cadastro, pix_copied, inscricao) still come back, sorted by created_at desc, with no _id. The prebuilt admin bundle (public/donaspainel main.fda9cfa5.js) maps kind 'lembrete' to a green icon (#16a34a). 6/6 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: The lembrete event meta stores the candidate's CPF and email in the events collection, and the realtime endpoint returns it. Admin-only, but storing less PII would be better.
The /admin/dashboard/realtime default limit is 10000, which is a large payload if the frontend leaves out the limit parameter.

Each lembrete run adds one event per recipient, so repeated clicks on the same day fill the feed with duplicate entries. There is no per-day dedupe for events (the inscricao 'lembrete_enviado_dia' field is set but not checked).
